edges.title: replayable version succession
edges.text: After a classified invalidation, the current version can freeze as provenance while its carried replay procedure is used to build and independently witness the next version.
edges.removal: Without x3Cd succession loses its portable executable replay body; without UoYa replay lacks explicit version authority and a rule for when predecessor authority ends.

edges.title: executable evidence-backed successor reconstruction
edges.text: Revocation can reopen the exact evidence and reconstructive body implicated by a failed typed contract, rebuild the relation, and rerun its tests before authority returns.
edges.removal: Without x3Cd the reconstruction is not an executable replay procedure; without ZwWN there is no typed frontier-conditioned object specifying what must be rebuilt.

edges.title: replay-directed dual revision
edges.text: Replay may first reopen evidence and co-revise scaffold plus transition law, then rerun the obligation and pressure tests on the repaired realization rather than merely replaying yesterday's machinery.
edges.removal: Without x3Cd dual revision lacks a replay passport; without M9zZ replay cannot earn joint revision of scaffold and transition family from reacquired tissue.

edges.title: boundary-conditioned successor contract
edges.text: A successor contract is created only after an event is classified as warrant-breaking and the revised typed obligation is reconstructed and pressure-tested against the changed frontier or regime.
edges.removal: Without UoYa reconstruction lacks version-transition authority; without ZwWN version transition lacks the evidence-backed typed contract and frontier.

edges.title: versioned renewal cycle
edges.text: The predecessor freezes as provenance, repair may reopen omitted tissue and revise realizational law, and only a freshly tested candidate becomes the next current warrant.
edges.removal: Without UoYa renewal lacks explicit version succession; without M9zZ succession lacks reacquirable co-revision when the old scaffold or mapping is part of the failure.

edges.title: frontier-repair co-revision
edges.text: Repair may alter both what is retained and how it is translated when the old frontier or regime fails, while the revised public contract must still pass current pressure.
edges.removal: Without ZwWN co-revision lacks a typed frontier-conditioned contract and authority gate; without M9zZ reconstruction cannot reopen omitted material and revise scaffold plus transition law together.

faces.title: versioned replayable successor reconstruction
faces.text: A warrant-breaking event is classified against the current version and frontier, the predecessor is retained unchanged, implicated evidence is reacquired and reconstructed, and carried replay tests decide whether a candidate successor may become current.
faces.removal: Remove x3Cd and executable replay is lost; remove UoYa and explicit authority succession is lost; remove ZwWN and the typed evidence-backed reconstruction target is lost.

faces.title: replayable warrant-renewal lifecycle
faces.text: The failure path itself is executable: classify invalidation, preserve the expired version, reopen dormant evidence where needed, co-revise scaffold and transition law, and rerun the predecessor's tests before issuing a successor.
faces.removal: Remove x3Cd and renewal is no longer executable state; remove UoYa and versioned authority transition disappears; remove M9zZ and repair cannot co-revise machinery from reacquired tissue.

faces.title: executable evidence-backed repair program
faces.text: A bounded repair program starts from a failed typed contract, preserves exact evidence addresses, reopens newly relevant dormant material, revises scaffold and transformation law where pressure demands, and reruns composite and frontier tests without claiming interior identity.
faces.removal: Remove x3Cd and replayable evidence/test state is lost; remove ZwWN and the typed successor gate is lost; remove M9zZ and reacquisition-backed co-revision is lost.

faces.title: frontier-classified co-revisionary successor contract
faces.text: Scope change is classified before repair, the frontier and evidence body define what must be retested, and scaffold plus transition family may be revised together from reacquired tissue before a fresh successor is admitted.
faces.removal: Remove UoYa and explicit succession is lost; remove ZwWN and the typed frontier target is lost; remove M9zZ and realizational machinery cannot be co-revised.

volume.title: replayable continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text: Every current warrant carries not only its scoped operational and evidential contract but a bounded executable route for producing a successor if that warrant becomes invalid. On failure or verified boundary change, predecessor authority freezes as provenance; the event is classified against the frontier, regime and scaffold; newly load-bearing evidence is reacquired; contract, scaffold and transition family are revised as necessary; pressure and composite tests are replayed; and a freshly scoped successor is issued only after witness. Continuity persists as a lineage of re-earned warrants, not silent transfer of expired authority.
volume.invariant: A continuity lineage across repeated realization change is warranted only when every current warrant carries its scoped contract and an executable successor-production route after invalidation, including classified failure, reacquirable evidence, revisable contract/scaffold/transition law, rerun tests, and freshly scoped successor authority.
removal: Remove 3H.x3Cd: the portable executable recovery passport is lost.
Remove 3H.UoYa: explicit version authority and predecessor/current/successor semantics are lost.
Remove 3H.ZwWN: the typed frontier-conditioned reconstruction target and evidence-gated successor body are lost.
Remove 3H.M9zZ: reacquirable dormant-body repair and joint scaffold/transition revision are lost.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-ADDRESSABLE-REPLAY
metabolites.text: When a continuity warrant fails, its failure class, evidence and reconstruction addresses, and falsifying tests must remain executable enough to reopen the relevant body and rerun the conditions required for a successor.
metabolites.compression: A failure that cannot address its own repair evidence cannot reliably seed a successor.

metabolites.title: CO-REVISED-SUCCESSOR-ISSUANCE
metabolites.text: After frontier, regime, or scaffold failure, successor authority is issued only after relevant evidence is reacquired, public contract and realizational machinery are revised as needed, and the new composite passes fresh pressure tests while the predecessor remains unchanged provenance.
metabolites.compression: Repair the relation and its realization law together when failure demands it; then issue new authority.

metabolites.title: SELF-RENEWING-CONTINUITY-LINEAGE
metabolites.text: Each accepted continuity version may participate in a self-renewing lineage only when it includes the bounded recovery passport, provenance, evidence addresses, and tests required to create and validate its own successor after invalidation.
metabolites.compression: Continuity becomes renewable when every current warrant carries a lawful way to stop being current and to seed the next one.
